rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for mustard as a condiment or sauce.

example.english: A hamburger isn't as tasty without mustard.
example.traditional: 漢堡包唔落芥辣就冇咁好食。
example.jyutping: hon3 bou2 baau1 m4 lok6 gaai3 laat6 zau6 mou5 gam3 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this especially when referring to mustard powder or mustard used as a spice rather than a prepared sauce.

example.english: Add a little mustard when making curry; it will be much more fragrant.
example.traditional: 做咖喱嗰陣加少少芥末，香好多。
example.jyutping: zou6 gaa3 lei1 go2 zan6 gaa1 siu2 siu2 gaai3 mut6 hoeng1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for the mustard plant itself, especially when discussing it as a leafy vegetable.

example.english: Mustard greens are in season lately; let's buy a catty to make soup.
example.traditional: 呢排芥菜當造，買返斤煲湯啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 gaai3 coi3 dong1 zou6 maai5 faan1 gan1 bou1 tong1 laa1
